glossary.definition: The Homeowners Association in the USA whose Board Members and Members use the solution.
A HOA role with administrative access: manages announcements, tickets, payments, the vendor directory and member information.
A HOA role with limited access, based on their own account. The BRD also calls this role "Society Member".
Information the Board publishes for Members (not event or party related).
A separate announcement form the Board uses to publish party or event-related information.
A Member's report of an HOA-related concern or request, handled by Board Members.
A payment request the Board raises for a list of HOA Members; each raise creates one Payment per listed Member.
One Member's payment entry, created from a Raise Payment. Tracked only; Members do not pay online.
A reminder a Member receives for an upcoming payment, approximately one month before the due date.
A weekly reminder a Member receives after the due date until the Payment is Paid, Waived or Cancelled.
A document a Board Member uploads when recording a Payment as Paid; seen by Board Members and the entry's own Member only.
A PDF a Member downloads for one Payment: HOA name, Member, title, amount, due date, status; once Paid it adds paid date and method.
A service provider used or recommended by the HOA, listed in the vendor directory (grass cutting / landscaping, plumber, electrician, maintenance and other HOA service providers).
A government identity document collected for each vendor; contains sensitive personal information.

purpose.text: Maintain a directory of HOA members and manage member accounts.

kpis.text: All Members registered within 1 month of go-live.

asIs.text: Today the member list is kept in a spreadsheet; there is no one up-to-date member list.

Access the information associated with their own account

requirements.title: Member registration form
requirements.statement: The member registration form captures Name, Phone and Address (required) and Email, Number of Family Members and Number of Cards (optional).
acceptance: A registration cannot be saved without Name, Phone and Address.

requirements.title: Member account scope
requirements.statement: Each registered member has access only to the information associated with their own account.
acceptance: A Member cannot open another Member's account information.

requirements.title: Complete directory for Board Members
requirements.statement: Board Members can view the complete member directory.
acceptance: Board Members see all registered members.

requirements.title: Member onboarding
requirements.statement: A new member is registered, gets a member account, is added to the HOA directory, and then gets access to the relevant modules.
acceptance: After registration, the member sees exactly the modules their role allows.

requirements.title: Manage member information
requirements.statement: Board Members can manage member information (add and update members).
acceptance: Board Members can manage HOA members.
Members cannot add or edit member records.

requirements.title: Member status
requirements.statement: A Member is Active or Inactive; a Board Member sets a Member Inactive when they move out or sell, the record is kept and their login stops.
acceptance: An Inactive Member cannot log in and still shows in the Board Members' directory with status Inactive.
A Member record cannot be deleted.

requirements.title: Login invite on registration
requirements.statement: When a Board Member registers a Member, no approval is needed and the Member gets a login invite.
acceptance: A newly registered Member receives a login invite without any approval step.

requirements.title: Total number of members
requirements.statement: Board Members see the total number of Members.
acceptance: A Board Member sees the count of Members, split by Active and Inactive.

mapping.how: Member → Employee record set up for HOA Members: Name, Phone, Address, Email, Number of Family Members, Number of Cards as fields; status Active / Inactive (exit as status change, record kept); Board Member and Member roles scoped so a Member sees only their own account; login invite as an automation; directory sheet and Headcount report for Board Members; fit for non-employee people to verify (OI-38); Member sees only own account, Board Members the full directory; family members recorded under the primary Member with no separate login; Number of Cards purpose open (OI-05)

purpose.text: Let the HOA Board communicate important information to Society Members.

kpis.text: Fix: all Members see notices in one place.

asIs.text: Today notices do not reach all Members in one place, so some are missed.
TO-BE: Board Member creates announcement → announcement published → Members view announcement.

roles.does: Create, publish and view announcements; publish Event / Party Announcements
View General and Event / Party Announcements (read-only)

transitions.trigger: Board Member archives; Event / Party Announcement archives after the event date

rules.action: Any Board Member publishes; no approval step
No create, edit or delete action offered
All Members notified by Neome app notification
All Members notified by Neome app notification

exceptions.text: Published announcement wrong or out of date: Board Member edits or archives it; not deleted.
Event / Party Announcement archives after its event date.

reports.measures: Event / Party Announcements with event date from today (potential dashboard)

volumes.text: Volumes: no limit; announcements, events, Members and Board Members are unlimited.

requirements.title: General announcements
requirements.statement: Board Members can create announcements, publish them, and view previously published announcements.
acceptance: Board Members can create and publish announcements.
Members can view announcements but cannot modify them.

requirements.title: Member read-only access
requirements.statement: Members have read-only access to announcements and cannot create, modify, or delete them.
acceptance: A Member is offered no create, edit or delete action on any announcement.

requirements.title: Event and party announcements
requirements.statement: Board Members can publish party or event-related announcements through a separate form.
acceptance: The event / party form is separate from the general announcement form.
The form holds Event title, Event description, Event date, Start time, End time, Venue / location and Contact person; Event title and Event date are required.

requirements.title: General announcement form
requirements.statement: A General Announcement holds Title, Message and Publish date (required) and an optional Attachment.
acceptance: A General Announcement cannot be published without Title and Message.

requirements.title: Announcement stages
requirements.statement: An announcement moves Draft → Published → Archived; a Board Member can edit or archive a published announcement, and an Event / Party Announcement archives after its event date.
acceptance: A Draft is not visible to Members.
An Archived announcement no longer shows in the Members' current list and is not deleted.

requirements.title: Publish without approval
requirements.statement: Any Board Member can publish an announcement without another Board Member's approval.
acceptance: A Board Member's publish makes the announcement visible to Members at once.

requirements.title: New announcement and event notifications
requirements.statement: Members are notified when a new announcement or a new Event / Party Announcement is published.
acceptance: On publish, every Member gets a Neome app notification.

requirements.title: Upcoming events
requirements.statement: Board Members see a list of upcoming events.
acceptance: A Board Member sees Event / Party Announcements with an event date from today, soonest first.

mapping.how: General Announcement → Forum post in an Announcements category; Event / Party Announcement → post in an Events category with event fields (no RSVP, so no Event Management ); only Board Members may post, Members read-only; no pre-publish approval; Draft / Published / Archived stages; new-post Neome app notification to Members; Upcoming events list for Board Members; HOA Members as people who are not employees (OI-38)

purpose.text: Let Members report HOA-related concerns or requests and let Board Members resolve them.

kpis.text: Every concern tracked in one place; every ticket gets a Board response.

asIs.text: AS-IS: concerns are not tracked in one place and some get no Board response.
TO-BE: Member raises ticket → Board Member reviews ticket → Board Member takes action → ticket status updated → Member views update → ticket closed.

roles.does: Raise tickets, view and track their own tickets, view Board responses and updates
Raise tickets; view all tickets; review, act on and update status; provide updates or comments

Board Member marks the ticket resolved

rules.action: Member sees only tickets they raised

rules.action: Board Member sees all tickets
Only a Board Member can change status
No assignment to one Board Member; any Board Member picks it up; no response-time target; no approval step
Member who raised it notified, Neome app notification

rules.when: Board Member adds an update or comment
rules.action: Member who raised it notified, Neome app notification
Board Members notified, Neome app notification

exceptions.text: Member not satisfied with a resolution: Member raises a new ticket; a closed ticket is not reopened.
Ticket raised by mistake or a duplicate: Board Member closes it with a comment.

volumes.text: No volume limits; all entries unlimited.
Members raise tickets from phone, with a photo when allowed.

requirements.title: Raise tickets
requirements.statement: Members can create tickets related to community or HOA matters.
acceptance: Members can raise HOA-related tickets.
A ticket cannot be saved without Ticket title, Category and Description.

requirements.title: Member ticket view
requirements.statement: A Member sees only the tickets they created, can track their status, and can view responses or updates provided by Board Members.
acceptance: Members can view only their own tickets.

requirements.title: Board ticket handling
requirements.statement: Board Members can view all tickets submitted by all members, review ticket details, act on tickets, update ticket status, and provide updates or comments.
acceptance: Board Members can view and manage all tickets.

requirements.title: Ticket lifecycle
requirements.statement: Ticket status moves through Open, In Progress, Resolved and Closed.
acceptance: Every ticket is in exactly one of the four statuses at any time.
Only a Board Member can change a ticket's status.

requirements.title: Ticket updates and comments
requirements.statement: Board Members add updates or comments on a ticket, and the Member who raised it sees them on the ticket.
acceptance: Each update shows who wrote it and when.
A Member sees every Board update on their own ticket.

requirements.title: Ticket notifications
requirements.statement: The Member who raised a ticket is notified when its status changes or a Board Member responds.
acceptance: On a status change or new Board update, the Member gets a notification on the agreed channel.
Board Members are notified when a new ticket is raised.

requirements.title: Shared Board queue
requirements.statement: Tickets are not assigned to one Board Member; any Board Member can pick up and act on any ticket, with no approval step.
acceptance: Every Board Member sees every Open ticket and can move it to In Progress.

requirements.title: Close without reopen
requirements.statement: A Board Member closes a resolved ticket; a closed ticket is not reopened, and a Member who is not satisfied raises a new ticket.
acceptance: A Closed ticket offers no status change.

requirements.title: Ticket dashboard
requirements.statement: Board Members see open tickets and tickets by status.
acceptance: A Board Member sees the count of tickets per status and the list of tickets not Closed.

mapping.how: Ticket → Ticket with HOA categories (Maintenance / Landscaping / Security / Noise / Other) and fields Ticket title, Category, Description, Attachment / photo, Date, Priority; own stages Open / In Progress / Resolved / Closed; raiser = Member, who sees only own tickets; Board Members as one shared queue, no assignment, SLA or approval; Ticket update → ticket comments and status history; status-change, response and new-ticket notifications by Neome app notification only; Open tickets and Tickets by status reports; close without reopen; HOA Members as people who are not employees (OI-38)

TO-BE: Board Member picks Members from the member list, or all Members; saving creates one Payment entry per listed Member.

requirements.title: Raise Payment
requirements.statement: Board Members can create a payment request / collection for HOA members.
acceptance: Board Members can raise payment collections.
A Member has no raise action.
A raise cannot be saved without Payment title, Amount, Due date and at least one Member.

requirements.title: One Payment entry per listed Member
requirements.statement: Each raise holds a list of Members and inserts one entry per listed Member into Payment.
acceptance: Saving a raise for N Members creates N Payment entries, one per Member, with the raise's amount and due date.

requirements.title: Pick Members, or all
requirements.statement: The Board Member picks the Members for a raise from the member list, or picks all Members; there is no limit on Members per raise.
acceptance: One action selects every Member.
Only Members in the Member Directory can be picked.

requirements.title: Raise stages and cancel
requirements.statement: A raise moves Draft → Raised with no second Board Member approval, and a Board Member can cancel it, which cancels its unpaid Payment entries.
acceptance: A Draft raise creates no Payment entries.
Cancelling a raise cancels every unpaid entry; paid entries stay.

requirements.title: New payment request notification
requirements.statement: Each listed Member is notified when a payment is raised for them.
acceptance: On saving a raise, every listed Member gets a notification on the agreed channel.

requirements.title: Raises list
requirements.statement: Board Members see a list of raises with category, due date, Members count and total amount.
acceptance: A Board Member can filter raises by category and due date.

mapping.how: Raise Payment → new record built on the Neome platform: form with Payment title, Description, Amount, Due date, Payment category master list (Annual dues / Special assessment / Other), Applicable members picked from the Member Directory with select all (Employee Directory people, OI-38); stages Draft / Raised / Cancelled, no approval; on save a workflow automation creates one Payment entry per Member and sends the new payment request notification by Neome app notification; raises list as a sheet with filters; no payment gateway

purpose.text: Track one Payment entry per Member per raise: Members see their own and get reminders; Board Members see all and record payment. No online payment.

kpis.text: More Payment entries paid by the due date; no overdue entry left unchased.

asIs.text: Pain: Members must get notification alerts for dues.
AS-IS: dues tracked in a spreadsheet; Board chases unpaid Members by hand and misses some.
TO-BE: Raise Payment creates Payment entry → Member views pending payment → reminder one month before due date → Board Member records payment with proof → payment history updated.

View own Payment entries and history; download invoice; see own proof of payment; receive reminders; no status action

Entry is paid in full or stays Pending / Overdue

rules.action: Member notified, Neome app notification only

volumes.text: No limit on raises, so no limit on Payment entries.
Retention: no limit; Payment entries kept.

No volume limits; all entries unlimited.

requirements.title: Member payment view
requirements.statement: Each Member can view their current pending payments, upcoming payments, previous payment history, payment amount and payment status, for their own account only.
acceptance: Members can view their pending payments and payment history.
A Member cannot see another Member's payment information.

requirements.title: Payment reminder
requirements.statement: Members receive a reminder for upcoming payments approximately one month before the payment due date, by Neome app notification only.
acceptance: Members receive upcoming payment reminders about one month before the due date, as a Neome app notification; no email is sent.

requirements.title: Board payment overview
requirements.statement: Board Members can view payments for all members, see paid, pending and overdue payments separately, and track payment status.
acceptance: Board Members can monitor paid, pending and overdue payments.

requirements.title: Raise payment collection
requirements.statement: Board Members can create a payment request / collection for HOA members.
acceptance: Board Members can raise payment collections.

requirements.title: Payment tracking only
requirements.statement: The system only tracks Payment entries; Members do not pay online and there is no payment gateway.
acceptance: No Payment screen offers an online pay action.

requirements.title: Board Member records payment received
requirements.statement: A Board Member marks a Member's Payment entry as Paid, recording paid date, payment method, an optional reference number and a proof of payment document.
acceptance: Once marked Paid, the entry moves from pending to paid in the Member's payment history.
The proof of payment document is visible to Board Members and to the entry's own Member only.

requirements.title: Only Board changes status
requirements.statement: Only Board Members can change a Payment entry's status.
acceptance: A Member has no status action on any Payment entry.

requirements.title: Payment stages
requirements.statement: A Payment entry moves Pending → Overdue automatically after the due date, and ends Paid, Waived (with a reason) or Cancelled (raise cancelled); part payment is not allowed.
acceptance: An unpaid entry shows Overdue the day after its due date.
Waived needs a reason.
An entry cannot be marked paid for part of its amount.

requirements.title: Download invoice
requirements.statement: A Member can download a PDF invoice for each of their Payment entries.
acceptance: The invoice shows HOA name, Member, title, amount, due date and status; once Paid it adds paid date and method.

requirements.title: Overdue reminder
requirements.statement: A Member receives an overdue reminder weekly after the due date until the entry is Paid, Waived or Cancelled.
acceptance: Reminders stop once the entry is Paid, Waived or Cancelled.

requirements.title: Payment received notification
requirements.statement: A Member is notified when a Board Member marks their Payment entry Paid.
acceptance: The Member gets a Neome app notification when the entry is marked Paid; no email is sent.

requirements.title: Board payment dashboard
requirements.statement: Board Members see total due, collected, pending and overdue amounts, by raise and by Member, and an overdue list.
acceptance: A Board Member can filter the dashboard by raise and by Member.

requirements.title: Undo wrong Paid
requirements.statement: A Board Member can set a wrongly Paid entry back to Pending or Overdue with a reason; the change is logged.
acceptance: The log shows who changed it, when and why.

requirements.title: Keep payment records
requirements.statement: Payment entries, proof of payment documents and status changes are kept with no time limit.
acceptance: A Board Member can open any past Payment entry with its proof and change log.

mapping.how: Vendor → Vendor (vendor master) only, no purchase requests or orders; Service Type / Category as a master list; Government ID Proof as a restricted document field seen by Board Members only, kept forever (no delete; encryption at rest is platform standard); Active / Inactive stages; Members read-only with a category filter on Active vendors; HOA Members as people who are not employees (OI-38); hangs on OI-58

requirements.title: Role-based access
requirements.statement: Role-based access is implemented for Board Members and Members as per the Access Control Matrix.
acceptance: Each function in the Access Control Matrix is allowed or denied per role exactly as listed.
A Member sees only their own account, not the Member Directory; Board Members see the full directory.
Vendor Government ID Proof is seen by Board Members only.

requirements.title: Currency, language and date format
requirements.statement: The system uses USD, English and the US date format.
acceptance: Amounts show in USD, screens in English, dates in US format (MM/DD/YYYY).

requirements.title: Support after go-live
requirements.statement: Neome gives support after go-live for as long as the subscription runs.
acceptance: Support is available to the HOA for the whole subscription period.

requirements.title: Notification channel
requirements.statement: All Modules, Payment included, notify by Neome app notification only; no email, SMS or WhatsApp.
acceptance: Every notification in every Module is sent as a Neome app notification; none is sent by email, SMS or WhatsApp.

requirements.title: Board dashboard
requirements.statement: Board Members have a dashboard showing total Members; open tickets and tickets by status; payments due, collected, pending and overdue; upcoming events.
acceptance: A Board Member sees each listed figure on one dashboard, matching the records.

requirements.title: No volume limits
requirements.statement: No volume limits apply; Members, vendors, tickets, payments and other entries are unlimited.
acceptance: No Module caps the number of entries.

na.reason: not in scope; standard Neome hosting and Neome login.
